items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: Bob Sheppard. Then there’s this piano solo. And it gets pretty intense. And then you come in and there’s a lot of space.

ctx.x: Bob Sheppard. Then there’s this piano solo. And it gets pretty intense. And then you come in and there’s a lot of space. And I’m wondering, I was thinking how deliberate and how preplanned was that?

I wouldn’t say preplanned at all, because I always leave a lot of space. I’ve had people say, “man I like the way you leave space.” Sometimes if they compliment me it’s because of the space I leave. Pete Erskine said that to me one time, he said, “I like how you leave space.” So to me it just helps me listen to them and maybe I can kind of — not that I want them to copy me or mark me or anything like that, but it also gives me ideas when I leave space. Like with Joe, Joe never repeats what I play but it’s just…
